## Feature Description

A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Category

- [ ] New challenge type / flag format
- [ ] Scoring system (dynamic scoring, brackets, etc.)
- [ ] Team management
- [ ] User profile / authentication (OAuth provider, etc.)
- [ ] Admin panel / competition management
- [ ] API / OpenAPI spec
- [ ] Backup / restore
- [ ] Notifications / WebSocket
- [ ] Observability (metrics, tracing, logging)
- [ ] CI / deployment / infrastructure
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Use Case

Describe the CTF hosting scenario where this feature would be useful.

## Proposed Implementation

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented (new endpoint, DB schema changes, config option, etc.), describe them here.

## API Impact

- [ ] Requires new API endpoint(s) - describe briefly
- [ ] Requires changes to existing endpoint(s)
- [ ] Requires DB migration
- [ ] Requires new environment variables
- [ ] No API / schema changes needed

## References

Links to relevant CTF platforms, RFCs, or other tools that implement similar functionality.
